title: Aimer X2
features:
Aimer X2 has manual aimbot activation. Other than its same as Aimer X (X1). After executing this script, only 1 out of 3 features will be auto activated.

Auto-activated features:
1. Hitbox
2. N/A

Manual-activated features:
1. Aimbot
2. ESP


Note: We did not create the aimbot script. Aimbot credit is in the notification.

Note 2: This script is great for mobile if Aimer X is giving trouble in mobile

Note 3: Aimbot has some bugs, it may not aim the person you are aiming for.










Note 01001110(Announcement): we will add an Q Tool that will aim he person you click on and will only work in FPS games only
